params.name: domain
params.description: Company web domain (e.g. stripe.com). Multiple companies may share the same domain due to acquisitions, mergers, or other reasons. In such cases, only the company with the highest valuation is returned. For precise lookups, prefer querying by caplightId or pitchbookId.

params.name: quarter
params.description: Filter to a specific quarter (e.g. 1Q2024). Mutually exclusive with quarterFrom/quarterTo.

params.name: quarterFrom
params.description: Filter to quarters starting from this quarter (inclusive). Use with quarterTo for a range.

params.name: quarterTo
params.description: Filter to quarters up to this quarter (inclusive). Use with quarterFrom for a range.

items.docs: Returns mutual fund mark-to-market valuations for a company from SEC filings. Fund marks represent the fair value prices reported by mutual funds in their quarterly holdings disclosures (N-PORT filings). These are valuable data points for gauging private company valuations as assessed by institutional investors.
